name: Audio Boost
status: Live - applications via the Yorkshire Sound Women Network website and social media; sessions start week commencing 4 January 2027
whoFor: Women (cis and trans) and gender-diverse people in Kirklees who are not in work or claiming Universal Credit and are living with a health condition, who want skills and confidence for work in the audio sector.
locations: Various locations in Huddersfield (to be confirmed), with online support
3M Buckley Innovation Centre, Firth Street, Huddersfield, HD1 3BD
eligibility: Women (cis and trans) and gender-diverse people
Economically inactive (not working and not looking for work)
Has the right to work in the UK
Has a health condition or disability
gate: Is economically inactive (not working and not looking for work)
Has the right to work in the UK
referralRoutes: Application details will be shared on the Yorkshire Sound Women Network website and social media later in autumn 2026

activities.name: Audio Boost
activities.summary: Hands-on workshops, talks and one-to-one support covering music technology roles such as producing tracks, DJing, engineering live events and making podcasts and radio shows, plus practical advice on finding work, in a friendly, supportive environment.
activities.duration: Six one-day workshops with online support throughout, starting week commencing 4 January 2027

provenance.source: Kirklees HWL Pathways Aug 26 v2.1 (draft 15 Sept 2026; grant-funded schemes added 12 Oct 2026)
provenance.evidence: Checked by PL on 2026-11-02: added address Eligibility set to the Healthy Working Life grant funding criteria by the programme team (2 November 2026): Kirklees resident, economically inactive, right to work in the UK, health condition or disability, 18+ unless the scheme says otherwise.
